observations: Photo 0 shows a 4-burner gas cooker with a stainless steel body and black grates. The front has three knobs and a control panel with indicator lights. The back has a grey tiled backsplash.

Photo 1 shows the same cooker with all four burners lit, producing blue flames. The front has four burners, two on the left and two on the right, with a central circular burner. The back has a tiled backsplash.

Photo 2 shows the top of the cooker with a glass lid and a stainless steel front panel with multiple circular holes and a handle. The oven door is open, revealing a dark interior. The cooker is placed on a dark, worn floor.
The seller claims it has 4 gas burners and 2 burners, totaling 6 burners, but only 4 are visible in the photos. The 2 burners are not shown.
The cooker appears to be a 4-burner gas hob with an oven, as suggested by the oven door in photo 2.
The photos show the cooker in use (burners lit) and in a kitchen setting, but no brand or model is visible on the unit.

claims.claim: 4 Gas cooker and 2 burner making 6 burner in total.
claims.evidence: Only 4 burners are visible in the photos. The 2 burners are not shown, and the claim of 6 burners cannot be verified from the images.
The burners are lit in photo 1, showing they are functional, but no proof of oven operation, ignition, or other functions is provided. The claim is not fully supported by the photos.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The oven may not be functional or may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing the oven door closed and the interior, or a video of the oven being lit and operated.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not having an oven

risks.risk: The 2 burners mentioned in the claim may not exist or may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo showing the 2 burners, or a video demonstrating their operation.

risks.risk: The cooker may have internal damage or gas leaks not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the gas flow, ignition, and flame stability, or a professional inspection report.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unsafe or non-functional

proof_requests: Photo of the oven door closed, showing the interior and control panel.
Photo or video showing the 2 burners in operation.
Video demonstrating the oven being lit and operated.
Video showing the gas flow and ignition of all burners.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
